vocab.sentence: It was raining, so we took a taxi.

vocab.sentence: How did the doctor treat your sore knee?

vocab.sentence: My aunt works as a nurse at night.

vocab.sentence: Why was your little brother sick yesterday?

vocab.sentence: My aunt bought a blue coat for me.

vocab.sentence: I eat vegetables because they keep me healthy.

tips.label: 授與動詞
tips.text: 人先物後：give 人 物；物先人後：give 物 to 人、buy 物 for 人。

tips.label: Why 的用法
tips.text: 問原因用 Why；be 動詞放主詞前，一般動詞用 do／does／did + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

tips.label: Because 和 So
tips.text: because 後接原因；so 後接結果。同一組因果子句不要同時用 because 和 so。

tips.label: Because 和 Because of
tips.text: because + 主詞 + 動詞；because of + 名詞或名詞片語。

notes.title: 授與動詞的兩種句型
notes.rule: S + V + 人 + 物；S + V + 物 + to／for + 人
notes.description: give、send、show、write、pass 的物在前時用 to；buy、make、cook 用 for。人直接放在動詞後、物放最後時，不加介系詞。本課物用 it／them 時，採「物 + to／for + 人」。
examples: The doctor gave Ben some medicine.
The doctor gave some medicine to Ben.
Mom bought a coat for Amy.

notes.title: Why 的用法
notes.rule: Why + be 動詞 + 主詞 ...?；Why + do／does／did + 主詞 + 原形動詞 ...?
notes.description: Why 問原因。問狀態時將 be 動詞放主詞前；問一般動詞的動作時用 do、does 或 did。did／did not 後面的動詞都用原形。回答可用 Because + 原因子句。
examples: Why does Tom wear a mask every day?
Why did you call the doctor?
Why didn't Amy take her medicine?

notes.title: Because 和 So 的因果順序
notes.rule: 結果 + because + 原因；Because + 原因, 結果；原因, so + 結果
notes.description: because 帶出原因，so 帶出結果。because 子句放句首時，後面用逗號分開。同一組因果子句不寫成 Because ..., so ...。
examples: I stayed home because I had a fever.
Because I had a fever, I stayed home.
I had a fever, so I stayed home.

notes.title: Because 和 Because of 的差別
notes.rule: because + 子句；because of + 名詞／名詞片語
notes.description: 先看後面有沒有主詞與動詞。he was sick 是完整子句，用 because；his illness 是名詞片語，用 because of。不能只看中文都譯為「因為」就混用。
examples: Tom missed school because he had a fever.
Tom missed school because of his fever.
Because the weather was bad, we stayed home.
Because of the bad weather, we stayed home.

quiz.question: The doctor sent the test results ___ my mother.
quiz.hint: send + 物 + to + 人，表示把物品或資訊傳送給某人。

quiz.question: My cousin bought a soft pillow ___ Grandpa.
quiz.hint: buy + 物 + for + 人，表示為某人購買物品。

quiz.question: Please show your health report ___ the school nurse.
quiz.hint: show + 物 + to + 人，表示把某物給某人看。

quiz.question: Dad made a bowl of soup ___ our sick neighbor.
quiz.hint: make + 物 + for + 人，表示為某人製作某物。

quiz.question: Please pass the clean mask ___ the patient.
quiz.hint: pass + 物 + to + 人，表示把物品遞給某人。

quiz.question: My sister cooked some rice ___ our grandmother.
quiz.hint: cook + 物 + for + 人，表示為某人煮食物。

quiz.question: The little girl wrote a thank-you note ___ her doctor.
quiz.hint: write + 信件或便條 + to + 人，表示寫給某人。

quiz.question: The nurse gave a glass of water ___ the thirsty boy.
quiz.hint: give + 物 + to + 人，表示把物品給某人。

quiz.question: My parents bought ___ a new pair of shoes.
quiz.hint: buy + 人 + 物中的人是受詞，要用受格 me。

quiz.question: The doctor gave ___ some tips about exercise.
quiz.hint: give 後的人是受詞，要用受格 us。

quiz.question: Our teacher sent ___ a message about the sick student.
quiz.hint: send + 人 + 物中的人用受格 them。

quiz.question: This medicine is for Dad. Please give it to ___.
quiz.hint: to 後接受格 him，指前句的 Dad；此處不是反身用法。

quiz.question: Those towels are for the children. Please pass ___ to them.
quiz.hint: pass 後需要受詞，代替複數 towels 用 them。

quiz.question: Mom made ___ a warm drink for her sore throat.
quiz.hint: make + 人 + 物中的人用受格 her，表示媽媽為她做飲料。

quiz.question: ___ did the boy miss the race? Because his knee hurt.
quiz.hint: 回答提供膝蓋痛這個原因，因此用 Why 問原因。

quiz.question: Why ___ your face red right now?
quiz.hint: face 是單數名詞，red 描述狀態，現在的問句用 is。

quiz.question: Why ___ the nurses so busy yesterday afternoon?
quiz.hint: yesterday afternoon 表示過去，複數主詞 nurses 搭配 were。

quiz.question: Why ___ your mother check your temperature every morning?
quiz.hint: every morning 表示習慣，單數主詞 your mother 的一般動詞問句用 does。

quiz.question: Why ___ you visit the hospital last Friday?
quiz.hint: last Friday 表示過去，visit 是一般動詞，問句用 did。

quiz.question: Why did the doctor ___ your eyes with a light?
quiz.hint: 助動詞 did 後用原形 check。

quiz.question: Why didn't your cousin ___ the nurse about his headache?
quiz.hint: didn't 後用原形 tell，不再使用過去式 told。

quiz.question: Why does the baby ___ her ears at night?
quiz.hint: does 後用原形 touch，不能再加 es。

quiz.question: Why ___ your feet so cold now?
quiz.hint: feet 是複數，cold 描述狀態，現在的問句用 are。

quiz.question: Why ___ your uncle absent from work yesterday?
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去，單數主詞 your uncle 搭配 was。

quiz.question: Why do the students ___ their hands before lunch?
quiz.hint: do 後的主要動詞用原形 wash。

quiz.question: Why didn't Amy ___ her medicine after breakfast?
quiz.hint: didn't 後用原形 take，不用過去式 took。

quiz.question: The girl wore a mask ___ she had a cough.（選出引出原因子句的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: she had a cough 是完整原因子句，前面用 because。

quiz.question: The floor was wet, ___ the nurse walked carefully.（選出引出結果的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: 地板濕是原因，小心走路是結果，因此用 so。

quiz.question: ___ his arm hurt, Jack could not carry the box.（選出引出原因子句的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: his arm hurt 有主詞與動詞，是原因子句，用 Because。

quiz.question: The child had a high fever, ___ his mother called a doctor.（選出引出結果的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: 發燒是原因，媽媽找醫生是結果，所以用 so。

quiz.question: We opened the window ___ the room was too hot.（選出引出原因子句的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: the room was too hot 是說明原因的完整子句，用 because。

quiz.question: My sister's neck hurt, ___ she stopped looking at her phone.（選出引出結果的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: 脖子痛是原因，停止看手機是結果，用 so 連接。

quiz.question: ___ the soup was too hot, I waited before eating it.（選出引出原因子句的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: the soup was too hot 是完整原因子句，前面用 Because。

quiz.question: The doctor was late, ___ we read books in the waiting room.（選出引出結果的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: 醫生遲到是原因，在候診室看書是結果，用 so。

quiz.question: I used my left hand ___ my right shoulder hurt.（選出引出原因子句的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: my right shoulder hurt 是完整原因子句，用 because。

quiz.question: Grandpa could not hear me, ___ I spoke louder.（選出引出結果的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: 聽不見是原因，說得更大聲是結果，用 so。

quiz.question: The player missed practice ___ his sore ankle.（選出表示原因的片語。）
quiz.hint: his sore ankle 是名詞片語，表示原因要用 because of。

quiz.question: The boy could not sleep ___ his tooth hurt.（選出表示原因的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: his tooth hurt 有主詞與動詞，用 because 引出原因子句。

quiz.question: We took a taxi ___ Grandma's knee pain.（選出表示原因的片語。）
quiz.hint: Grandma's knee pain 是名詞片語，前面用 because of。

quiz.question: ___ the heavy rain, the doctor arrived late.（選出表示原因的片語。）
quiz.hint: the heavy rain 是名詞片語，前面用 Because of。

quiz.question: Sue drank more water ___ she had a fever.（選出表示原因的連接詞。）
quiz.hint: she had a fever 是完整子句，用 because。

quiz.question: The game ended early ___ a player's illness.（選出表示原因的片語。）
quiz.hint: a player's illness 是名詞片語，前面用 because of。

quiz.question: The singer canceled the show because ___.
quiz.hint: because 後接主詞加動詞；her throat hurt 是完整子句。

quiz.question: The nurse went home early because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語 her headache，不能直接接完整子句。

quiz.question: Ben stayed away from the pool because ___.
quiz.hint: because 後要接完整子句，he had a cold 有主詞和動詞。

quiz.question: The school closed for a day because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語 the strong wind。

quiz.question: ___ does the nurse wear gloves? Because she needs to protect her hands.
quiz.hint: 回答說明戴手套的原因，問句用 Why。

quiz.question: Why did the teacher ___ the sick child's parents?
quiz.hint: did 後用原形 call，不能再用過去式 called。

quiz.question: This is your aunt's letter. Please send it ___ her.
quiz.hint: send + 物 + to + 人，it 是寄送的物品。

quiz.question: These sandwiches are for the nurses. Dad made them ___ the nurses.
quiz.hint: make + 物 + for + 人，them 指三明治。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 你爸爸為什麼上班時戴手套？

grammar.sentence: The player rested because of his sore ankle.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那名球員因為腳踝痠痛而休息。

grammar.sentence: My grandmother cooked some vegetable soup for me.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我奶奶為我煮了一些蔬菜湯。

grammar.sentence: The room was hot, so we opened the door.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 房間很熱，所以我們打開門。

grammar.sentence: Why didn't the patient finish his breakfast?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那位病人為什麼沒有吃完早餐？

grammar.sentence: Please pass the bottle to the thirsty player.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請把那個瓶子遞給那位口渴的球員。

grammar.sentence: I stayed awake because my stomach hurt.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我因為肚子痛而一直醒著。

grammar.sentence: My brother wrote a note to our nurse.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我哥哥寫了一張便條給我們的護士。

grammar.sentence: Why is your face so red right now?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你的臉現在為什麼這麼紅？

grammar.sentence: The school closed because of the heavy snow.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 學校因為大雪而停課。

grammar.sentence: The doctor gave the child a small toy.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 醫生給那個孩子一個小玩具。

grammar.sentence: Because his shoulder hurt, he stopped swimming.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 因為他的肩膀痛，他停止游泳。

grammar.sentence: Why do you wash your hands before meals?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你為什麼在吃飯前洗手？

grammar.sentence: My aunt bought a soft pillow for Grandpa.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我阿姨買了一個柔軟的枕頭給爺爺。

grammar.sentence: The floor was wet, so I walked slowly.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 地板濕了，所以我慢慢走。

grammar.sentence: Please send the good news to your parents.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請把這個好消息傳給你的父母。

grammar.sentence: Why was the doctor late for work today?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那位醫生今天為什麼上班遲到？

grammar.sentence: She missed the race because of her cold.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她因為感冒而錯過比賽。

grammar.sentence: Dad made the hungry children some hot noodles.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 爸爸為飢餓的孩子們煮了一些熱麵。

grammar.sentence: I drank warm water because my throat hurt.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我因為喉嚨痛而喝溫水。

grammar.sentence: Why didn't your brother bring his clean mask?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你弟弟為什麼沒有帶他的乾淨口罩？
